summary: Kohl's Corp filed an 8-K on May 20, 2026, announcing a quarterly cash dividend of $0.125 per share, payable June 24, 2026 to holders of record June 10, 2026, and issued a press release regarding its Annual Meeting of Shareholders. No extraordinary special-situations event occurred; the filing covers routine dividend declaration and meeting results. The filing does not relate to an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, or other special situation. Final voting results will be reported separately. This is a routine current report, not a special situation.
